templates.name: Initial Application Follow-up
templates.subject: Following up on {job_title} Application
templates.body:
Hi {contact_name},

I hope this email finds you well. I recently applied for the {job_title} position at {company_name} and wanted to reach out to express my continued interest.

With my background in software development, I believe I would be a strong fit for your team. I'm particularly excited about {company_name}'s mission.

I'd love the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to {company_name}'s success.

Best regards,
{user_name}
editing_tips: Personalize with specific skills relevant to the role
Mention something specific about the company

templates.name: LinkedIn Networking Message
templates.body:
Hi {contact_name},

I came across your profile while researching {company_name} and was impressed by your work in {contact_role}.

I'm currently seeking opportunities and would love to learn more about your experience at {company_name}. Would you be open to a brief conversation?

Thank you for considering my request!

Best,
{user_name}
editing_tips: Show genuine interest in their work
Don't immediately ask for a job

templates.name: Post-Interview Thank You
templates.subject: Thank you for the {job_title} interview
templates.body:
Dear {contact_name},

Thank you for taking the time to speak with me about the {job_title} position at {company_name}. I enjoyed learning more about the role and the team.

Our conversation reinforced my enthusiasm for this opportunity.

Please let me know if you need any additional information from me. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
{user_name}
editing_tips: Send within 24 hours of the interview

templates.name: Cold Outreach to Hiring Manager
templates.subject: Inquiry about opportunities at {company_name}
templates.body:
Hi {contact_name},

I hope this message finds you well. My name is {user_name}, and I'm interested in opportunities at {company_name}.

I've been following {company_name}'s work and am impressed by your innovation. My dream is to {dream_milestone}, and I believe {company_name} would be the perfect place to achieve this.

Would you be open to a brief conversation about how I might contribute to your team?

Thank you for your time!

Best,
{user_name}
editing_tips: Show genuine interest in their mission
Be clear about what you're looking for

templates.name: Referral Request from Connection
templates.subject: Referral request for {job_title} at {company_name}
templates.body:
Hi {contact_name},

I hope you're doing well! I wanted to reach out because I noticed that {company_name} has an opening for {job_title}, and I'm very interested in applying.

Given your experience at {company_name}, I was wondering if you might be willing to refer me or provide insights about the role and team.

I'd be grateful for any guidance you can provide!

Thank you so much for considering my request.

Best,
{user_name}
editing_tips: Only reach out to people you actually know
Make it easy for them to help you
